target_customer: NFT marketplaces, launchpads and creators who want buyers to pay by card without a crypto wallet
problem: Buying an NFT required crypto and a wallet, which blocked mainstream buyers. Winter offered an embeddable checkout accepting card or bank payments.
business_model: Payments take rate on NFT sales through an embeddable checkout and API

founders.name: Michael Luo
founders.background_notes: Ex Facebook product manager and ex Zillow software engineer per YC page. Did not join Crossmint after the deal per The Block.

founders.name: Laila Chima
founders.background_notes: Former CTO, now a life coach per YC page.

competitors.name: MoonPay NFT Checkout
competitors.what: Plug and play card checkout for NFT purchases for brands and marketplaces
competitors.traction_then: launched with brand and marketplace partners

competitors.name: Crossmint
competitors.what: Card payments for NFT sales, for example Formfunction instant sales
competitors.traction_then: integration announced Sept 2022, claimed 30 to 50 percent sales lift

technical_complexity.rationale: Payments, fraud and chargeback handling and custodial wallets for NFTs were fiddly but built on existing processors.

defensibility.rationale: Several rivals launched the same checkout in the same weeks, and the product relied on payment processors anyone could use.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: MoonPay launched an equivalent in January 2022. Crossmint later acquired Winter in February 2024.

market_need_then: NFT trading boomed in 2021 and early 2022 and card payment was a known onboarding barrier, but demand collapsed through 2022 and 2023.

branding.domain_note: Winter.xyz was referenced by a Product Hunt search, not confirmed here

identity.voice_and_tone: developer API product launches on Product Hunt

branding.community_and_virality: Three Product Hunt launches in 2022 and 2023, one hunted by Michael Seibel

brand_strength.rationale: Generic common word with no evidence of brand recognition beyond Product Hunt launches.

pivots.to: NFT claim API for free claims, gaming and rewards
pivots.why: Not stated; launch on Product Hunt shows widening of the product as sales demand fell

outcome_analysis: Winter built card checkout for NFTs in YC Winter 2022 just as the NFT market peaked and, within weeks, MoonPay shipped the same feature. NFT volume then fell sharply, the team widened into claim APIs, and Crossmint bought it in February 2024 with undisclosed terms and without the founder joining. That looks like an asset and customer pickup rather than a successful outcome.
notes: Directory lists no website so no company site was fetched. Unverified: CB Insights lists about $500K total raised with Crossmint and YC as investors, single aggregator, not recorded as a round. Market decline reasoning is inferred from timeline and not stated by a Winter source.
